concept:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a crisp premium portfolio website design screenshot, desktop 1440x1000 aspect ratio. Entire requested site is ONLY top navigation and one hero, no other sections or footer. Image 1 is the portrait asset, use this SAME photo of Lahcen standing with gray suit at green carved doors, no pose change needed for concept. Aim for an understated editorial art direction with white #ffffff background, deep forest green #183c32 headings, muted gray body, black typography; crisp grotesk type similar to Helvetica or PP Radio Grotesk. No gradients, pills, badges, cards, floating panels or shadows.
Header 96px tall with 72px side gutters and a hairline bottom border: left wordmark 'Lahcen Aharouane'; right navigation 'GitHub' 'LinkedIn' and an outlined green 'Say hello' button with small diagonal arrow. Simple generous spacing.
Hero occupies rest of screen. Two columns: left 570px area starts at x72 and right portrait at x820 y168 width480 height640 (3:4). Render the ENTIRE exact photo within that rectangular frame, no tint, no overlay, corners just 3px radius. Main headline left x72 y275 in large 96px regular-to-medium weight grotesk on two lines: 'Lahcen' then 'Aharouane.' with tight tracking. Below at y505, clear 20px body exact text: 'Digital product developer based in Casablanca.' then 'I turn ideas into thoughtful digital experiences.' wrapped naturally over 3 lines total max440px. At y645 a forest green rectangular button white text 'Let’s talk' plus simple up-right arrow. Below image, tiny muted caption 'Move your cursor. I’ll follow.' and simple cursor icon. Below left at y790 small 'Casablanca, Morocco'. Only these text strings. Strong alignment, lots of white breathing room, real photo as dominant visual, no extra decoration. Code-native text and buttons when implemented. Output only the design screenshot, not a device mockup.
